title: Polar bears have BLACK skin?! 🐻‍❄️ #shorts
description:
Gizmo Jr. says he knows everything about animals… wrong again. 🤖
Fizzo brought three animal facts that sound fake but are 100% true. ⚡

Which one got you? Comment below! 👇
Follow for a new mind-blowing fact every day!

#facts #funfacts #didyouknow #animals #shorts
facts_checked: Polar bears have black skin under their fur; the hairs are transparent (not white) and only look white because they scatter light (Polar Bears International).
Owls cannot move their eyes in their sockets, so they turn their heads instead, up to about 270 degrees (National Geographic, 2013).
Rabbits eat some of their own poop: soft droppings called cecotropes, full of nutrients and vitamins made by gut bacteria, which they re-eat straight from their bottom.
